title: Lagrangian–Eulerian learning of flow field and trajectories with TrajectoryFlowNet
title_zh: 基于TrajectoryFlowNet的拉格朗日-欧拉流场与轨迹学习
abstract: Predicting particle transport in complex flows is traditionally achieved by solving the Navier–Stokes equations. Numerical and experimental methods typically require deep physical insights and incur high computational costs. Although machine learning offers an alternative, existing approaches fail to generalize the prediction of long-range particle trajectories in sparse data regimes. Here, to this end, we propose TrajectoryFlowNet, a Lagrangian–Eulerian physics-informed neural network architecture, for fluid flow velocimetry and imaging via learning to predict spatiotemporal flow fields and long-range particle trajectories. The salient features of our model include its ability to handle complex flow patterns with irregular boundaries, predict the full-field flows, image the long-range flow trajectory of any arbitrary particle, and ensure physical consistency in predictions based on only scarce measurement of flow trajectories. We validate TrajectoryFlowNet via both numerical examples (for example, lid-driven cavity flow and complex cylinder flow) and experimental test cases (for example, aortic and ventricle blood flows) across diverse flow scenarios. The results demonstrate our model’s effectiveness in capturing intricate particle-laden flow dynamics, enabling long-range tracking of particles and accurate construction of flow fields in real-world applications. Wan et al. introduce a physics-informed learning model that simultaneously predicts long-range particle paths and flow fields based on very limited trajectory measurements, validated in both simulations and blood-flow experiments.
abstract_zh: 传统上，预测复杂流体中的粒子输运通常通过求解Navier–Stokes方程实现。数值和实验方法通常需要深厚的物理洞察并产生高昂的计算成本。尽管机器学习提供了另一种途径，但现有方法在稀疏数据条件下难以推断长程粒子轨迹。为此，我们提出了TrajectoryFlowNet，一种基于拉格朗日-欧拉的物理信息神经网络架构，用于通过学习预测时空流场和长程粒子轨迹，实现流体流速测量和成像。我们的模型的显著特点包括：处理具有不规则边界的复杂流动模式的能力、预测全场流动、对任意粒子进行长程流动轨迹成像，以及基于有限的流动轨迹测量确保预测的物理一致性。我们通过数值示例（例如驱动腔流和复杂气缸流）以及实验测试案例（例如主动脉和心室血流）在多种流动场景中验证了TrajectoryFlowNet的有效性。结果表明，我们的模型在捕捉复杂的带粒子流动动力学方面具有有效性，能够实现粒子的长程跟踪，并为现实应用中准确构建流场提供支持。Wan等人介绍了一种物理信息学习模型，该模型基于有限的轨迹测量，同时预测长程粒子路径和流场，并在模拟和血流实验中进行了验证。
